title: Chapter 3 climate developmental replacement: scoped acquisition and rereading register
status: Proposed replacement for parent review; not integrated chapter or final-book approval.
counting_rule: One new published participant interview in two related language versions, plus one new contemporary report of public remarks. Versions of the interview count as one source. Neither source is a new scholarly article or an acquired private record.

sources.title: 解振华：让气候目标倒逼改革
sources.title_english_for_reference: Xie Zhenhua: using climate targets to drive reform (our reference translation)
sources.publisher: Caixin / 财新《新世纪》; edited English excerpts published by ChinaFile
sources.source_type: Contemporaneous published participant interview, edited by the interviewing publication.
sources.access_status: Public HTML acquired without authentication; no bypass or outreach.
sources.reading_status: Complete published Chinese interview and attached biography read; complete English excerpt publication read.
sources.reading_limits: Neither raw interview recording nor a complete verbatim underlying transcript was acquired. The English version explicitly consists of excerpts and is not coextensive with the Chinese version.

decisive_locators.heading: 酝酿已久 当天定稿
decisive_locators.content: September leader communication, domestic target choice, mutual comfort, contacts and finalization; top-level attention.

decisive_locators.heading: 有雄心、有力度的目标
decisive_locators.content: Public account of domestic restructuring rationale and leadership requirements.

decisive_locators.heading: 气候目标不会让GDP增速大降
decisive_locators.content: Nearly two years of modeling, disagreement among estimates, central leadership and State Council decision.

decisive_locators.heading: 中美共赢
decisive_locators.content: First three Q&A exchanges: targets nationally decided, agreement not to negotiate each other’s targets qualified by unavoidable discussion, and teams evaluating both sides’ effort.

decisive_locators.heading: 达标路线图
decisive_locators.content: Domestic planning/legal characterization; kept distinct from international target-result obligations.

sources.supports: A direct Chinese participant account allowing comparison with Stern on reciprocal acceptability, domestic analytical disagreement and political choice. The Chinese original gives the decisive national-choice versus mutual-endorsement distinction omitted from the English excerpts.
sources.limits: Public defense of the policy, not independently verified internal instructions or proof of why leaders chose a particular number. Does not quantify a reciprocal trade of increments or prove delivery. Technical and economic claims elsewhere in the interview are not adopted as independently verified findings.
sources.chronology_control: Xie foregrounds Zhang Gaoli’s September message and implementation of leaders’ understandings; Stern describes an earlier US January–February initiative. Their emphases do not supply a fully reconciled chronology and do not by themselves demonstrate contradiction.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Distinct interview with the Chinese participant, not a repetition of Stern; Chinese original and ChinaFile excerpts remain one interview chain. Related short Caixin reports from the same interview are not additional witnesses.

versions.reading: complete published body, all Q&A, attached biography

versions.title: Clearing the Air With a Sino-U.S. Climate Pact: Hu Shuli Leads Interview with China’s Chief Climate Negotiator, Xie Zhenhua
versions.reading: complete published excerpts, not complete original interview

sources.title: US-China chat broke impasse at Lima climate talks
sources.author: Ed King
sources.publisher: Climate Home News / Climate Change News; contemporary article originally dated December 16, 2014
sources.event_scope: Closing Lima conference, including a Saturday-afternoon meeting between Stern and Xie and remarks at early-Sunday press conferences.
sources.source_type: Contemporary original reporting of public participant remarks, with reporter interpretation of their significance.
sources.reading_status: Complete current article body read, excluding unrelated site navigation and recommendations.
sources.decisive_locator: Article body beginning with the late envoys’ meeting; paragraphs describing the differentiation language and attributed remarks by Stern, Figueres and Javadekar.
sources.supports: Attributes a proposal of bilateral differentiation wording to Stern and Xie and records different public readings of the resulting formulation.
sources.limits: Original 2014 webpage version, raw reporting notes, press-conference recordings and official transcripts not recovered. The private meeting was not documented here independently. The claim that the meeting saved the conference is the reporter’s causal interpretation and is not adopted as established.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: A separate reporter from ENB, but quotations of Stern remain Stern’s public account; final Lima text establishes wording, not independent access to the private drafting exchange.
